name: UW-La Crosse at Luther Dual
headline: UW-La Crosse at Luther
summary: No. 3 UW-La Crosse women and No. 5 UW-La Crosse men run a Friday dual at Luther in Decorah, women at 4:45 p.m. and men at 5:15 p.m. Most ranked D-III teams are off before conference championships on Oct. 30–31; the only other ranked team racing this weekend is No. 22 Haverford men at the Haverford Invitational.
